entries.title: Before the record: the run-up to Sebring, January 12, 2019, then the 173 races

values.label: one scale, 2016 to 2026: the three karting years in proportion to the seven and a half of the record, their labels fanned out along the top; the record one square per race (new, default)
the run-up: the scale breaks at the flag so the karting years get the stage, labels standing on their marks; the record squeezed into the last third
